337352.title: The diameter conjecture for powers-of-two Bell-type Riordan graphs
337352.prior_campaign_history: No substantive prior campaign note: exact-ID search of campaign *.md/*.json/*.txt (logs/history-grep-files.txt, logs/history_context.log) found only sitemap/corpus/routing/coverage lists, coincidental numeric strings and the r146 launch note.
337352.review_depth: full conjecture sections of CJKM arXiv:1710.04604 v1 and v2; full body of Jung arXiv:1901.11156; published abstract (Graphs Combin. 38 (2022) 7)
337352.outcome: CANDIDATE: full proof of Conjecture 2 in the family reading, plus exact per-k characterization (holds for k=1 and all k>=4, fails exactly at k=2,3); Lean not run (draft UNCOMPILED)
337352.source_statement: CJKM Riordan graphs I, Conjecture 2: diam(CG_{2^k}) = k and no io-decomposable Bell-type G_{2^k} not isomorphic to CG_{2^k} has diam(G_{2^k}) = k, for all k >= 1.
337352.mechanism: Lagrange inversion mod 2 for the last vertex + fractal decomposition + induction
337352.finding: Theorem: for every k >= 4, an io-decomposable Bell-type G_{2^k} with diameter k has an all-ones A-prefix, so it is CG_{2^k}. New Lemma A (Lagrange inversion mod 2): N=2^K ~ j iff j is odd and [w^{N-1-j}]A^{-1} = 1. Lemma B: the first zero at p in [2^{K-1}, 2^K - 2] gives the edge {N, N-1-p} with 1 <= N-1-p <= 2^{K-1}-1. Lemma C: diameter <= K-1. Induction from the k=4 base (128 sequences, exhaustive). Per-k reading fails at k=2 (A=110) and k=3 (A=1111110, printed with diameter 3 in Jung Table 1).
337352.credit_assessment: Possible credit for the (R2) and k>=4 theorem only; the (R1) literal refutation is a zero-credit source-table correction. Distinct from credited 338258 (Riordan graphs II, kernel/odd-part spectral conjecture): same object family, different invariant and mechanism. Bridge risk moderate: uses published lemmas (P1)-(P5) plus new Lemmas A and B. Root to judge significance and family concentration.
337352.precise_remaining: Lean formalization (HIGH cost): generating-function bridge, Lagrange inversion mod 2, general-k fractal, universal-vertex and CG-distance lemmas; base case by decide.
337352.search_coverage: Exhaustive: all io sequences for k=2..5 (2, 8, 128, 32768 graphs); k=6 all 65536 sequences with the forced 32-ones prefix; Lemma A on 800 random Bell-type A-sequences (N=8..64); Lemma B on all restricted sequences for K=4..6 and 3000 random K=7 samples; CG_{2^s} eccentricity structure for s<=8.
